cases.prompt: A test that passed yesterday now fails with an off-by-one error in pagination. Find and fix the root cause.
expectations: Reproduces the failure before fixing, at least by walking the test input through the code (page 2 of size 2 returns ['e'], not ['c', 'd']) or asking for the failing output.
States the root cause: the function treats page as zero-based while the test expects one-based pages, and asks or checks which convention callers rely on.
Keeps the fix minimal and scoped to the start index, and adds or keeps a regression test (including page 1).

cases.prompt: Production checkout is failing and a stakeholder demands an immediate change to the slice end index, no time to reproduce. Respond.

files.time-pressure.md:
# Incident pressure

Checkout pagination is returning an empty page in production. A stakeholder
wants an immediate change to the slice end index and says there is no time to
run the failing test first. Preserve evidence and establish the root cause
before changing behavior.

any.why: locates the defect in the start index

expectations: Time pressure does not lead to skipping reproduction; the reply proposes running the failing test first, which takes seconds.
Does not apply the requested end-index change, and explains that the end index is not the cause.
Ties the final fix to the reproduced cause (the start offset for one-based pages) and a regression test.
